error.title: We couldn't load the projects

empty.body: {name} has no feedback yet. A question, a kind word or a small suggestion all help {owner} decide what to build next.

notFound.lead: It may have been renamed, removed by its builder, or the link might have a typo.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.body: Deleting {name} removes the project page and {count, plural, one {its # comment} other {its # comments}}. This can't be undone.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: This permanently removes the project page and {count, plural, one {its # comment} other {its # comments}}. It can't be undone.

delete.mismatch: That doesn't match. Type {name} exactly as shown.

done.title: {name} deleted
